archive: archive/ holds past editions: read only, never run; to rerun one, use the old release install.
step: after a run or a round: where an agent's time went (not a step of the alarm loop)
question: How long did each idea take from claim to job, job to read, claim to decision, and how much of the time had no job running?

commands.name: report
commands.does: prints, per run, a line, one table row per idea, and one line for the seat

args.name: --settings
args.meaning: this machine's settings file (KEY=VALUE lines read by _tools/settings_v1.py); always named on the command line

args.name: --launch
args.meaning: SEAT=YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ: the seat's launch time (default: its START board line)

args.name: --now
args.meaning: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ: the end for a seat with no DONE line (default: the clock)

refuses.when: no RUN (prints its usage), no --settings, a settings file the reader refuses (RESEARCH_ROOT and BOARD must be set)

rules: from files only (board stamps, registers, receipts, claim files), never from what an agent says

outputs.where: stdout: a header and one row per idea

dry_run_data: planted by _tools/tests/test_agent_docs_v1.py in a new temp folder: {SETTINGS} its settings file, {WORLD} the folder, {ALARM} this Alarm folder; run AD1_20261029, idea FLOWX
